answer: A filer posts a dated work calendar on the Jetty board before payout, each milestone signed with a plume, copied into the velvet ledger. The desk checks each milestone against delivery within a day; a missed one voids the claim and forfeits a 400-coin bond. One honest worker risks one bond; 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 calendars and lose 400,000 coins. One farm posted forty calendars in one week; no work appeared, and every bond was gone Friday.
